usage: deskops advance task [-h] [--back] [--reason REASON] [--root ROOT]
                            task_id

Advance one actionable task through the desk's lifecycle graph.

positional arguments:
  task_id          Task selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename,
                   stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --back           Take the manual transition back (ritual-testing to ritual-
                   execution) instead of advancing; needs --reason.
  --reason REASON  Why the task goes back; recorded in history. Only with
                   --back.
  --root ROOT      Target repository root.

Example:
  deskops advance task task-fix-thing --root .
  deskops advance task task-fix-thing --back --reason "blocked: needs a design decision" --root .

Advancement fires the first lifecycle transition (an sldb RelationDoc between rituals) whose condition holds for the task.
--back takes only the manual transitions (attributes.manual: true) leaving the task's node.
Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
